entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I think I cracked my ass...
entries.uk: Здається, я відбив собі дупу надвоє...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Ann, are you all right!? Is yours cracked[n]as well?
entries.uk: Анн, ти ціла!? У тебе теж надвоє?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Isn't it supposed to be though?
entries.uk: А хіба не мала б бути?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Urgh, that's not what I mean!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: More importantly, it's dangerous for us[n]to just charge out like that!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.uk: Е-е, я б не сказав, що ніхто...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: It appears to have been the cause of[n]Morgana's demise...
entries.uk: Схоже, саме він і погубив Морґану...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: That's not what I meant! Isn't that[n]Kaneshiro's...
entries.uk: Я не про те! Це ж хіба не...[n]того Канешіро...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: We'd have security cameras to[n]worry about there.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Oh, I got the perfect place.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I was just in the mood for some[n]coffee too.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: And we need to fix Morgana up!
